Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the timber binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 8 separate vaults needs a separate funded hollow account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and hence the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. A 111 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
